instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Name who said each stretch of a call or recording, from the voices of people who agreed to be known", and give it file (The recording (audio or video), by identity in your files); segments (The transcript's timed stretches, in seconds, in order).
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:who-is-in-this and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Takes a recording and its transcript (the timed stretches tools/audio-transcription gives) and answers each turn with who said it: the person's name when one enrolled person is clearly the closest voice; every person it could be when two are too close to tell, so a guess is never made silently; otherwise an unknown voice with a number that stays the same for the whole listening, across every recording of it.
